SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, fiscal_week
FROM dim_date
WHERE calendar_date >= '2024-08-01' AND calendar_date <= '2024-09-30'
ORDER BY fiscal_week

WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2024-08-01' AS start_date, DATE '2024-09-30' AS end_date
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, 
           s.region,
           f.gross_amount AS gross_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT l.region,
       SUM(l.gross_sales)  AS gross_sales_incl_vat
FROM lines l
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE l.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY l.region

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, 
           s.region,
           f.gross_amount AS gross_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND business_date >= '2024-08-01' AND business_date <= '2024-09-30'
)
SELECT l.region,
       SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(l.business_date) = 8 THEN l.gross_sales ELSE 0 END) AS august_2024,

FROM lines l
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY l.region
